senses.en: a statement admitting that something is true
senses.pattern: an admission of guilt / an admission of failure / by one's own admission
senses.example: His silence during the meeting was taken as an [[admission]] that the mistake had been his.
senses.example_zh: 他在會議上的沉默被視為承認那個錯誤是他犯的。
senses.note: 動詞 admit；an admission of guilt 認罪

senses.en: the price charged to enter a place
senses.pattern: free admission / charge admission / half-price admission
senses.example: The museum charges adults ten dollars for [[admission]], but children under six get in free.
senses.example_zh: 這間博物館向成人收取十美元的入場費，但六歲以下兒童免費入場。

gsat.sentence: [[Admission]] is free for people young and old.

senses.en: an urgent request for help, money, or information
senses.pattern: make an appeal for / launch an appeal / an appeal to the public
senses.example: After the earthquake, the charity launched an urgent [[appeal]] for blankets, tents, and clean drinking water.
senses.example_zh: 地震過後，這個慈善團體緊急呼籲各界捐贈毛毯、帳篷和乾淨的飲用水。
senses.note: 也作動詞：appeal (to sb) for sth

senses.en: to ask a higher court to change a decision
senses.pattern: appeal against the verdict / appeal to a higher court / the right to appeal
senses.example: The company lost the case, but its lawyers plan to [[appeal]] to a higher court next month.
senses.example_zh: 這家公司敗訴了，但其律師打算下個月向上級法院提出上訴。
senses.note: 名詞同形：file an appeal 提出上訴

gsat.sentence: As blood supplies have fallen to a critically low level, many hospitals are making an [[appeal]] for the public to donate blood.

senses.en: a possible way of achieving something
senses.pattern: explore every avenue / an avenue for / a new avenue of research
senses.example: Before giving up on the project, the team explored every possible [[avenue]] for raising more money.
senses.example_zh: 在放棄這項計畫之前，團隊試過了每一種可能的募款途徑。

senses.en: money or extras given by an employer or the government
senses.pattern: unemployment benefits / employee benefits / claim benefits
senses.example: Workers who lose their jobs can apply for unemployment [[benefits]] while they look for new positions.
senses.example_zh: 失業的勞工在找新工作期間可以申請失業補助金。
senses.note: 此義常用複數 benefits

senses.en: an event held to raise money for charity
senses.pattern: a benefit concert / a benefit dinner / hold a benefit for
senses.example: Local musicians held a [[benefit]] last weekend to raise money for families who lost their homes in the flood.
senses.example_zh: 當地音樂人上週末舉辦義演，為在水災中失去家園的家庭募款。

gsat.sentence: “What started out as an extra one-day-a-week [[benefit]] for employees has really become an everyday thing,” said business consultant Maisly Jones.

senses.en: to reduce the gap or difference between two groups
senses.pattern: bridge the gap / bridge the divide / bridge their differences
senses.example: The new program aims to [[bridge]] the gap between students in cities and those in remote villages.
senses.example_zh: 這項新計畫旨在縮小城市學生與偏遠村落學生之間的差距。

senses.en: the raised part of a ship where the captain works
senses.pattern: on the bridge / the ship's bridge / return to the bridge
senses.example: The captain stayed on the [[bridge]] all night, steering the ship safely through the storm.
senses.example_zh: 船長整夜守在駕駛台，駕著船平安穿越暴風雨。
senses.note: 另可指「鼻梁」：the bridge of the nose

gsat.sentence: “A fishing ship came towards us with nobody on the [[bridge]] and ran us down.

senses.en: an aim or principle that people support or fight for
senses.pattern: a good cause / a worthy cause / fight for a cause / the cause of peace
senses.example: She has devoted her whole life to the [[cause]] of protecting endangered sea turtles.
senses.example_zh: 她把一生都奉獻給保護瀕危海龜這個目標。
senses.note: for a good cause：為了公益、做善事

senses.en: a good reason for feeling or doing something
senses.pattern: cause for concern / cause for celebration / without good cause
senses.example: The doctor said the test results were normal, so there was no [[cause]] for concern.
senses.example_zh: 醫生說檢查結果正常，所以沒有擔心的理由。
senses.note: 此義不可數，常接 for＋名詞

senses.en: polite in a formal way, though not friendly
senses.pattern: be civil to someone / a civil conversation / remain civil
senses.example: The two rivals disliked each other, but they managed to stay [[civil]] throughout the debate.
senses.example_zh: 這兩名對手互相看不順眼，但整場辯論中仍設法保持客氣。
senses.note: 名詞 civility：禮貌、客氣

senses.en: relating to private legal disputes, not crimes
senses.pattern: civil law / a civil case / a civil court / a civil lawsuit
senses.example: Because no crime was involved, the argument over the unpaid rent was settled in a [[civil]] court.
senses.example_zh: 由於不涉及犯罪，這場積欠房租的糾紛是在民事法庭解決的。
senses.note: 反義：criminal 刑事的

senses.en: a group of people sharing a job, interest, or background
senses.pattern: the scientific community / the business community / the international community
senses.example: The discovery was welcomed by the scientific [[community]], which had searched for an answer for decades.
senses.example_zh: 這項發現受到科學界的歡迎，科學界尋找答案已有數十年之久。

senses.en: all the plants and animals living in one area
senses.pattern: a plant community / marine communities / a community of microbes
senses.example: Pollution from the factory has damaged the [[community]] of fish and plants living in the lake.
senses.example_zh: 工廠的污染已破壞了湖中由魚類與植物構成的生物群落。

gsat.sentence: In the sixteenth century, when the Africans were taken from their homes to Brazil against their will and kept in slavery, Capoeira began to take form among the [[community]] of slaves for self-defense.

In addition to traditional course materials such as videos, readings, and problem sets, MOOCs provide interactive user forums that help build a [[community]] for the students, professors, and teaching assistants.

senses.en: to stop something harmful from spreading
senses.pattern: contain the fire / contain the outbreak / contain the spread of
senses.example: Firefighters worked through the night to [[contain]] the blaze before it reached nearby homes.
senses.example_zh: 消防員徹夜搶救，要趕在大火延燒到附近住家之前控制住火勢。

senses.en: to keep your feelings under control
senses.pattern: contain one's excitement / contain one's anger / can hardly contain oneself
senses.example: When her name was announced as the winner, she could hardly [[contain]] her excitement.
senses.example_zh: 當她的名字被宣布為優勝者時，她幾乎克制不住內心的興奮。

senses.en: annoyed or slightly angry
senses.pattern: be cross with someone / get cross about / a cross look
senses.example: Mom was [[cross]] with my brother because he had left his muddy shoes on the sofa.
senses.example_zh: 媽媽很生我弟弟的氣，因為他把沾滿泥巴的鞋子留在沙發上。
senses.note: 多見於英式英語；be cross with＋人

senses.en: a mixture of two different things or breeds
senses.pattern: a cross between A and B / a cross between two breeds / a poodle cross
senses.example: The fruit looks like a [[cross]] between a lemon and an orange and tastes surprisingly sweet.
senses.example_zh: 這種水果看起來像是檸檬和柳橙的混合體，嚐起來出奇地甜。

senses.en: a shape with four equal sloping sides
senses.pattern: a diamond shape / a diamond pattern / cut into diamonds
senses.example: The road sign was a yellow [[diamond]] with a black arrow pointing to the left.
senses.example_zh: 那個路標是一個黃色的菱形，上面有指向左邊的黑色箭頭。
senses.note: 撲克牌的「方塊」也叫 diamonds

senses.en: a baseball field, especially the infield
senses.pattern: a baseball diamond / on the diamond / around the diamond
senses.example: The children spent every summer afternoon playing baseball on the dusty [[diamond]] behind the school.
senses.example_zh: 孩子們每個夏日午後都在學校後面那座塵土飛揚的棒球場上打棒球。

senses.en: dull and boring, lacking interesting details
senses.pattern: a dry lecture / a dry subject / dry facts and figures
senses.example: The textbook was so [[dry]] that most students fell asleep after reading only two pages.
senses.example_zh: 這本教科書非常枯燥乏味，大多數學生才讀兩頁就睡著了。

senses.en: (of humor) funny while seeming serious
senses.pattern: dry humor / a dry wit / a dry sense of humor
senses.example: Our math teacher has a [[dry]] sense of humor and tells jokes without ever smiling.
senses.example_zh: 我們數學老師有種冷面的幽默感，講笑話時自己從來不笑。

senses.en: something submitted to a competition
senses.pattern: the winning entry / submit an entry / the closing date for entries
senses.example: The judges received over five hundred [[entries]] for this year's short story contest.
senses.example_zh: 評審收到了五百多件今年短篇小說比賽的參賽作品。

senses.en: a single item written in a dictionary, diary, or list
senses.pattern: a dictionary entry / a diary entry / the last entry in
senses.example: The last [[entry]] in the sailor's diary was written two days before the ship disappeared.
senses.example_zh: 那名水手日記的最後一則是在船失蹤前兩天寫下的。

senses.en: to happen on a particular day or date
senses.pattern: fall on a Sunday / fall on the same day / fall in early February
senses.example: My birthday [[falls]] on a Saturday this year, so we can have a party at the beach.
senses.example_zh: 我今年的生日適逢星期六，所以我們可以在海邊辦派對。

senses.en: to belong to a particular group or category
senses.pattern: fall into a category / fall into three groups / fall under the heading of
senses.example: Most of the complaints we received [[fall]] into two groups: slow delivery and damaged packaging.
senses.example_zh: 我們收到的投訴大多可歸入兩類：送貨太慢和包裝受損。
senses.note: 另：fall silent／ill＝變得沉默／生病

gsat.sentence: Flower and plant names like Heather, Rosemary, and Iris [[fall]] into this category.
Your dog could [[fall]] into one of nine categories: Ace, Stargazer, Maverick, Charmer, Socialite, Protodog, Einstein, Expert, or Renaissance Dog.

senses.en: to appear or move very quickly
senses.pattern: flash through one's mind / flash by / flash past / flash across the screen
senses.example: As the bus pulled away, the thought [[flashed]] through my mind that I had left my wallet on the seat.
senses.example_zh: 公車開走時，我腦中突然閃現一個念頭：我把錢包忘在座位上了。

senses.en: to show something quickly or for a moment
senses.pattern: flash a smile / flash an ID card / flash a look at
senses.example: The officer [[flashed]] his badge at the guard and walked straight into the building.
senses.example_zh: 那名警官向警衛亮出警徽，然後直接走進大樓。
senses.note: 名詞：a flash of inspiration 靈光一現

senses.en: to prevent a plan or effort from succeeding
senses.pattern: frustrate a plan / frustrate an attempt / frustrate someone's efforts
senses.example: Heavy rain [[frustrated]] the rescuers' attempts to reach the climbers trapped near the summit.
senses.example_zh: 大雨阻撓了搜救人員的行動，使他們無法抵達受困在山頂附近的登山客身邊。

senses.en: (of facts or evidence) definitely true and reliable
senses.pattern: hard evidence / hard facts / hard data
senses.example: The police suspected the manager, but they had no [[hard]] evidence to prove he had taken the money.
senses.example_zh: 警方懷疑那名經理，卻沒有確鑿的證據能證明錢是他拿的。

senses.en: strict or unkind; showing no sympathy
senses.pattern: be hard on someone / too hard on oneself / take a hard line on
senses.example: Don't be so [[hard]] on yourself; everyone makes mistakes when learning a new language.
senses.example_zh: 別對自己那麼嚴厲；每個人學新語言時都會犯錯。
senses.note: be hard on＋人：對某人嚴厲

senses.en: nearest in time, space, or relationship
senses.pattern: immediate family / the immediate future / the immediate neighborhood / immediate surroundings
senses.example: Only [[immediate]] family members, such as parents and children, were allowed to visit the patient.
senses.example_zh: 只有父母、子女等關係最親的家屬才獲准探視病人。
senses.note: immediate family＝至親（父母、配偶、子女等）

senses.en: existing now and needing urgent attention
senses.pattern: an immediate threat / immediate concern / immediate needs / in no immediate danger
senses.example: Our [[immediate]] concern is finding shelter for the victims; rebuilding the town can wait.
senses.example_zh: 我們當前最迫切的考量是為災民找到棲身之處；重建城鎮可以晚一點再說。

gsat.sentence: A newly published study, however, revealed that rising temperatures are posing an [[immediate]] threat to the last tropical glaciers in Indonesia’s Papua region.
So the stunt industry is probably in no [[immediate]] danger of dying off.

senses.en: the process of giving birth to a baby
senses.pattern: go into labor / be in labor / a difficult labor / labor pains
senses.example: She went into [[labor]] at midnight, and her daughter was born early the next morning.
senses.example_zh: 她在午夜開始分娩，女兒在隔天清晨出生。
senses.note: 英式拼法為 labour

senses.en: to work hard or move with great effort
senses.pattern: labor over a report / labor up the hill / labor to finish
senses.example: The old truck [[labored]] up the steep mountain road, with black smoke pouring from its engine.
senses.example_zh: 那輛老舊卡車艱難地爬上陡峭的山路，引擎不斷冒出黑煙。

senses.en: published writings on a particular subject
senses.pattern: the scientific literature / the literature on / a literature review / medical literature
senses.example: Before designing her experiment, she read all the available [[literature]] on sleep and memory.
senses.example_zh: 在設計實驗之前，她讀遍了所有關於睡眠與記憶的現有文獻。

senses.en: printed material giving information or advertising something
senses.pattern: sales literature / promotional literature / product literature
senses.example: The salesman handed me some [[literature]] describing the features and prices of the new washing machines.
senses.example_zh: 業務員遞給我一些介紹新款洗衣機功能與價格的宣傳印刷品。

senses.en: an animal's partner for producing young
senses.pattern: attract a mate / find a mate / choose a mate / compete for mates
senses.example: The male peacock spreads its colorful tail feathers to attract a [[mate]] during the spring.
senses.example_zh: 雄孔雀在春天時會展開色彩繽紛的尾羽來吸引配偶。

senses.en: (of animals) to come together to produce young
senses.pattern: mate with / mate for life / the mating season
senses.example: Many swans [[mate]] for life and raise their young together year after year.
senses.example_zh: 許多天鵝終生只與同一個伴侶交配，年復一年地共同撫育幼雛。

gsat.sentence: To me, a zoo can be a good place for endangered species which have difficulty finding suitable [[mates]] in the wild.
They [[mate]] at night near railways.

senses.en: the place where a river meets the sea; an opening
senses.pattern: the mouth of the river / the mouth of a cave / a river mouth
senses.example: The fishing village lies at the [[mouth]] of the river, where fresh water meets the sea.
senses.example_zh: 這個漁村位於河口，也就是淡水與海水交會的地方。

senses.en: to form words with the lips without making a sound
senses.pattern: mouth the words / mouth a silent thank-you / mouth something to someone
senses.example: From across the noisy room, she [[mouthed]] the words "call me later" and pointed to her phone.
senses.example_zh: 隔著吵雜的房間，她用嘴形無聲地說了「晚點打給我」，並指了指她的手機。
senses.note: 動詞讀作 /maʊð/，字尾發濁音

senses.en: to say that you disagree or disapprove
senses.pattern: object to a plan / object to doing something / strongly object
senses.example: Many residents [[object]] to building a factory so close to the elementary school.
senses.example_zh: 許多居民反對在離小學這麼近的地方蓋工廠。
senses.note: 動詞讀作 /əbˈdʒɛkt/，重音在後

senses.en: the purpose or aim of an action or activity
senses.pattern: the object of the game / the object of the exercise / with the object of
senses.example: The [[object]] of the game is to collect as many cards as possible before time runs out.
senses.example_zh: 這個遊戲的目的是在時間結束前盡可能收集最多的卡片。

senses.en: during a period of time
senses.pattern: over the years / over time / over the past decade / over the weekend
senses.example: The small town has changed a great deal [[over]] the past twenty years.
senses.example_zh: 在過去二十年期間，這個小鎮改變了許多。

senses.en: while eating a meal or having a drink
senses.pattern: over coffee / over lunch / over a cup of tea / over dinner
senses.example: Why don't we discuss the details of the trip [[over]] lunch tomorrow?
senses.example_zh: 我們何不明天邊吃午餐邊討論這趟旅行的細節？

senses.en: about or because of something
senses.pattern: argue over / fight over / worry over / grieve over
senses.example: The two brothers often argue [[over]] who should wash the dishes after dinner.
senses.example_zh: 這對兄弟常為了晚餐後該由誰洗碗而爭吵。

gsat.sentence: The movement continued [[over]] the years; however, the problem remains.
The idea for the wind phone was first brought forth by a Japanese garden designer named Itaru Sasaki, who was grieving [[over]] the death of his cousin in 2010, before the tsunami.

senses.en: to carry out a task, duty, or operation
senses.pattern: perform an operation / perform a task / perform an experiment / perform one's duties
senses.example: The surgeon [[performed]] a six-hour operation to repair the boy's damaged heart.
senses.example_zh: 外科醫師執行了長達六小時的手術，修補男孩受損的心臟。

senses.en: to work or do something well or badly
senses.pattern: perform well / perform poorly / perform under pressure / perform better than expected
senses.example: Students who get enough sleep tend to [[perform]] better on tests than those who stay up late.
senses.example_zh: 睡眠充足的學生考試表現往往比熬夜的學生好。
senses.note: 名詞 performance：表現、性能

gsat.sentence: Heroes are selfless people who [[perform]] extraordinary acts.
To [[perform]] well academically at school.

senses.en: to combine money or resources for shared use
senses.pattern: pool resources / pool money / pool ideas / pool one's savings
senses.example: The three roommates [[pooled]] their savings to buy a secondhand refrigerator for the apartment.
senses.example_zh: 三位室友把各自的積蓄集中起來，為公寓買了一台二手冰箱。

senses.en: a shared supply of people or things available for use
senses.pattern: a pool of talent / a pool of volunteers / a pool of applicants / a gene pool
senses.example: The company hires its managers from a large [[pool]] of experienced engineers.
senses.example_zh: 這家公司從一個龐大的資深工程師人才庫中聘用經理。

gsat.sentence: The names were chosen from a name [[pool]] composed of 140 names, 10 each from the 14 members of the committee.

senses.en: not liking to share thoughts and feelings
senses.pattern: a private person / a very private man / intensely private
senses.example: The famous author is a very [[private]] person who rarely talks about his family in interviews.
senses.example_zh: 這位知名作家是個不愛吐露心事的人，受訪時很少談到家人。

senses.en: a soldier of the lowest rank in the army
senses.pattern: an army private / a private in the army / the rank of private
senses.example: He joined the army as a [[private]] and became a captain within eight years.
senses.example_zh: 他以二等兵的身分入伍，八年內就升為上尉。

senses.en: to express doubt about whether something is true or right
senses.pattern: question a decision / question the wisdom of / question whether / question someone's honesty
senses.example: Several scientists have [[questioned]] the study's results because it tested only twenty people.
senses.example_zh: 有幾位科學家質疑這項研究的結果，因為它只測試了二十個人。

senses.en: to ask someone questions officially, especially about a crime
senses.pattern: question a suspect / question witnesses / be questioned by police / question someone about
senses.example: Police [[questioned]] three witnesses about what they had seen outside the bank that night.
senses.example_zh: 警方訊問了三名目擊者，了解他們當晚在銀行外看到了什麼。

senses.en: doubt or uncertainty about something
senses.pattern: call something into question / beyond question / open to question / no question that
senses.example: Her talent is beyond [[question]], but she still needs more experience on the stage.
senses.example_zh: 她的才華毫無疑問，但她仍需要更多舞台經驗。
senses.note: call … into question：對…提出質疑

gsat.sentence: After several years of physical suffering and near financial ruin from the medical costs, the couple began [[questioning]] the treatment after consulting with other patients in online support groups.
The scientist’s project to build a modern laboratory was called into [[question]] on account of its huge budget.

senses.en: considered in comparison with something else
senses.pattern: relative to / the relative merits of / in relative comfort / relative safety
senses.example: While the storm raged outside, the hikers waited in the [[relative]] safety of a small mountain cabin.
senses.example_zh: 外頭風雨交加時，登山客待在相對安全的小山屋裡等候。
senses.note: 副詞 relatively：相對地、相當

senses.en: the main cause or origin of a problem
senses.pattern: the root of the problem / the root cause / get to the root of / lie at the root of
senses.example: Poor communication, not a lack of money, lies at the [[root]] of the team's problems.
senses.example_zh: 這個團隊問題的根源在於溝通不良，而不是缺錢。
senses.note: 複數 roots 可指「祖籍、出身」

senses.en: to support or cheer for a person or team
senses.pattern: root for the home team / root for someone / root for the underdog
senses.example: The whole class came to the final to [[root]] for our school's basketball team.
senses.example_zh: 全班都來到決賽現場，為我們學校的籃球隊加油。
senses.note: 美式口語，固定搭配 root for

gsat.sentence: Jack: I wish I were a millionaire. I could buy whatever I want. Jane: Well, it may be true. But we must bear in mind that the love of money is also the [[root]] of all evil.

senses.en: the head of a government department
senses.pattern: the Secretary of State / the Education Secretary / the Health Secretary
senses.example: The health [[secretary]] announced a national plan to hire five thousand more nurses for public hospitals.
senses.example_zh: 衛生部長宣布了一項全國性計畫，要為公立醫院增聘五千名護理師。
senses.note: Secretary of State＝（美國）國務卿

senses.en: a new part growing from a plant
senses.pattern: bamboo shoots / green shoots / new shoots / young shoots
senses.example: After the spring rain, tiny green [[shoots]] began to appear all over the vegetable garden.
senses.example_zh: 春雨過後，菜園裡到處開始冒出細小的綠色嫩芽。
senses.note: bamboo shoots＝竹筍

senses.en: to move suddenly and very quickly
senses.pattern: shoot past / shoot across the sky / shoot out of / shoot ahead
senses.example: A bright meteor [[shot]] across the night sky and disappeared behind the mountains.
senses.example_zh: 一顆明亮的流星飛快劃過夜空，消失在群山之後。
senses.note: 過去式、過去分詞為 shot

senses.en: an occasion when photos or a film are taken
senses.pattern: a photo shoot / a film shoot / a fashion shoot / on a shoot
senses.example: The model arrived two hours early for the magazine's photo [[shoot]] at the beach.
senses.example_zh: 那位模特兒提早兩小時抵達海邊，準備進行雜誌的照片拍攝。

gsat.sentence: Jesse is a talented model. He can easily adopt an elegant pose for a camera [[shoot]].
In the earlier days of space travel, scientists tried to overcome the force of gravity so that a rocket could [[shoot]] free of Earth’s pull in order to land humans on the moon.

senses.en: to have a bad or unpleasant smell
senses.pattern: begin to smell / your feet smell / the trash smells
senses.example: Take the garbage out before you leave, or the whole kitchen will [[smell]] by tomorrow morning.
senses.example_zh: 出門前把垃圾拿出去，不然到明天早上整個廚房都會發臭。
senses.note: 後面不接形容詞時即指「有臭味」

senses.en: to sense that something is wrong or about to happen
senses.pattern: smell trouble / smell danger / smell a rat
senses.example: The experienced reporter [[smelled]] trouble as soon as the manager refused to answer any questions.
senses.example_zh: 那位經驗老到的記者一見經理拒絕回答任何問題，就察覺出事情不對勁。
senses.note: smell a rat＝覺得事有蹊蹺

senses.en: to wear or show something in a noticeable way
senses.pattern: sport a beard / sport a new haircut / sport a red tie
senses.example: My uncle came back from vacation [[sporting]] a thick beard and a bright Hawaiian shirt.
senses.example_zh: 我叔叔度假回來時留著濃密的鬍子，還穿著一件鮮豔的夏威夷衫。

senses.en: someone who stays cheerful when losing or teased
senses.pattern: a good sport / be a sport / a bad sport
senses.example: Jenny lost every round of the game, but she was a good [[sport]] and congratulated the winners.
senses.example_zh: 珍妮每一局都輸了，但她是個輸得起的人，還向贏家道賀。
senses.note: 常用 a good sport；反義 a bad sport

senses.en: happening one after another without a break
senses.pattern: five straight wins / three straight days / the third straight year
senses.example: The team won its seventh [[straight]] game last night and now leads the league.
senses.example_zh: 這支球隊昨晚連續第七場贏球，目前在聯盟中領先。

senses.en: directly or immediately, without stopping or delay
senses.pattern: go straight home / straight after school / go straight to bed / come straight from
senses.example: I was so tired after the trip that I went [[straight]] to bed without having dinner.
senses.example_zh: 旅行回來後我累到沒吃晚餐就直接上床睡覺。

senses.en: honest and direct
senses.pattern: a straight answer / be straight with someone / straight talk
senses.example: I asked him three times, but he refused to give me a [[straight]] answer about the cost.
senses.example_zh: 我問了他三次，他卻不肯就費用問題給我一個坦率的答覆。

gsat.sentence: Residents are told not to dump all household waste [[straight]] into the trash can; reusable materials should first be sorted out and recycled.

senses.en: to provide the money someone needs to live
senses.pattern: support a family / support oneself / support one's children / support aging parents
senses.example: After her father fell ill, she took a second job to [[support]] her younger brothers.
senses.example_zh: 父親生病後，她多兼了一份工作來扶養弟弟們。

senses.en: to help show that something is true
senses.pattern: support a claim / support a theory / evidence to support / be supported by data
senses.example: The results of the new experiment [[support]] the theory that the planet once had water.
senses.example_zh: 這項新實驗的結果佐證了該行星曾經有水的理論。

gsat.sentence: Although Jeffery had to keep two part-time jobs to [[support]] his family, he never neglected his studies. In fact, he graduated with honors.
The claim that eating chocolate can prevent heart disease is disputable because there is not enough scientific evidence to [[support]] it.

senses.en: an area of knowledge, activity, or experience
senses.pattern: unfamiliar territory / uncharted territory / familiar territory / new territory
senses.example: Teaching online was unfamiliar [[territory]] for most of the teachers, so they needed extra training.
senses.example_zh: 線上教學對大多數老師來說是陌生的領域，所以他們需要額外的訓練。

senses.en: an area that an animal defends as its own
senses.pattern: mark its territory / defend its territory / establish a territory
senses.example: A male tiger marks its [[territory]] by scratching trees and will attack any rival that enters.
senses.example_zh: 公老虎會抓樹幹來標示自己的地盤，並攻擊任何闖入的對手。

gsat.sentence: Male howler monkeys use their loud voices to fight for food, mates, or [[territory]].

senses.en: a series of connected thoughts or events
senses.pattern: a train of thought / a train of events / lose one's train of thought
senses.example: The power failure set off a [[train]] of events that ended with the whole factory closing for a week.
senses.example_zh: 這次停電引發了一連串的事件，最後導致整座工廠停工一週。
senses.note: train of thought＝思路

senses.en: to aim a camera, gun, or light at something
senses.pattern: train a camera on / train a telescope on / train a light on
senses.example: The photographers [[trained]] their cameras on the door, waiting for the singer to come out.
senses.example_zh: 攝影師們把相機對準門口，等著那位歌手走出來。
senses.note: 常用 train A on B：把 A 對準 B

senses.en: almost or very nearly the thing described
senses.pattern: a virtual standstill / a virtual certainty / a virtual stranger / virtual silence
senses.example: The heavy snow brought traffic in the city to a [[virtual]] standstill for most of the day.
senses.example_zh: 這場大雪使市區交通幾乎陷入停擺，持續了大半天。
senses.note: 副詞 virtually＝幾乎、實際上

senses.en: a limited period when something can be done
senses.pattern: a window of opportunity / a narrow window / a two-hour window / the window closes
senses.example: Doctors have only a short [[window]] of a few hours to treat patients after a stroke.
senses.example_zh: 中風之後，醫師只有短短幾小時的時機可以救治病人。
senses.note: window of opportunity＝大好時機

senses.en: a way of seeing and learning about something
senses.pattern: a window on / a window into / a window to the world
senses.example: Old letters like these offer a [[window]] into the daily lives of people a century ago.
senses.example_zh: 像這樣的舊信件提供了一個窗口，讓人了解一百年前人們的日常生活。

quiz.stem: Health officials moved quickly to ______ the outbreak by closing schools and tracing everyone who had been in contact with infected patients.
quiz.explain_zh: contain＝控制、遏止（蔓延）。衛生官員關閉學校並追蹤接觸者以遏止疫情。

quiz.stem: Since talks with the factory owner have failed, the residents now see legal action as the only remaining ______ for stopping the pollution.
quiz.explain_zh: avenue＝途徑、方法。協商破裂後，居民認為打官司是阻止污染的唯一途徑。

quiz.stem: Although the two neighbors had argued bitterly over the fence, they remained ______ to each other, exchanging polite greetings whenever they met in the elevator.
quiz.explain_zh: civil＝客氣的、有禮貌的。兩人雖曾激烈爭吵，見面仍客氣地打招呼。

quiz.stem: Because the national holiday ______ on a Sunday this year, workers will be given the following Monday off instead.
quiz.explain_zh: fall＝適逢（某日）。國定假日適逢星期日，所以星期一補假。

quiz.stem: Our school's science club submitted a solar-powered backpack as its ______ in the national invention competition and won third place.
quiz.explain_zh: entry＝參賽作品。科學社以太陽能背包作為參賽作品，獲得第三名。

quiz.stem: Many people claim that this herbal tea can cure a cold, yet scientists say there is no ______ evidence that it actually works.
quiz.explain_zh: hard＝確鑿的、可靠的。科學家表示沒有確鑿證據顯示花草茶能治感冒。

quiz.stem: By ______ their knowledge and equipment, the two research teams were able to finish the vaccine study in half the expected time.
quiz.explain_zh: pool＝集中（資源、資金）。兩個團隊集中知識與設備，研究提早完成。

quiz.stem: Thousands of runners signed up for the charity marathon because they believed in its ______: raising money to build a children's hospital.
quiz.explain_zh: cause＝（奮鬥的）目標、理想。跑者認同這場馬拉松募款蓋兒童醫院的目標。

quiz.stem: After winning the national championship for the fourth ______ year, the school's debate team was invited to compete overseas.
quiz.explain_zh: straight＝連續的。辯論隊連續第四年奪得全國冠軍。

quiz.stem: The goalkeeper's quick reflexes ______ every attempt by the visiting team to score in the final ten minutes of the match.
quiz.explain_zh: frustrate＝阻撓、使落空。守門員反應快，讓客隊最後十分鐘的射門全數落空。
